name: Voxel Realms RPG: Open World MMORPG & Castle Warfare
description: Advanced 3D HDR open world voxel RPG with castle expansion (Lv 0-100), T1-T20 troops (Shieldbearer, Shooter, Bomber), 1000T troop capacity, 1T rallies, Lv 1-1000 monsters, clan warfare, character creation centre, and power rankings.
